note: An empty collection is not an absent one. Section 3.1 has a reader treat them alike when reading and makes them different documents, so whether a collection was present is model state in the way a position's arity is, and section 8.1's round trip has to reproduce it. A library modelling a collection as a plain list, where absent and empty are one value, passes every case that carries neither. The file carries an empty top-level waypoints, an empty highlights array, and two empty objects, nodes and arcs, so the array case and the object case are both covered. It deliberately carries no empty folders and no empty routes: those keys are absent here. That asymmetry is what makes the file catch a reader in both directions at once, one that drops an empty collection and one that manufactures an empty collection from an absent key. Adding the missing collections for symmetry would delete half its power.
